NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT FOR
7353-59 SOUTH INDIANA AVENUE CHICAGO IL

The subject property is currently a vacant unimproved parcel. The Applicant is proposing to
redevelop this lot with a new two-story residential building with 8 dwelling units and 7-car
parking garage (the property is a Transit Served Location). The Applicant needs a zoning change
in order to comply with the bulk requirements (including the floor area ratio and the minimum lot
area per unit standards) of the Zoning Code to proceed with the proposed redevelopment.

Project Zoning Change from the RS2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
Description: to an RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

Use: Residential Building with 8 Dwelling Units and 7 parking spaces.

Lot Area: 66.57' x 160.28' = 10,669.84 SF (recorded measurements)

Floor Area Ratio: | 0.85

Floor Area: 8,880 SF (see plans attached)
Density: 1,333 Square Feet per DU

Off- Street Parking: 7 (reduction pursuant to Transit Served Location provisions)
Setbacks: Front Setback: 15”

North Side: 9°-6 %4”
South Side: 10°-0”
Rear: 487-1 % “
Open Space: 700 SF

Building Height 22’-6”

I. Optional Relief for Adjustment and Variation under Section 17-13-0303-D —

a Type 1] map amendment pursuant to Section 17-13-0300, may include relief available pursuant
to Section 17-13-1000 or 17-13-1100; in such instances, City Council approval of a Type-1
application containing said elements shall preclude subsequent review otherwise required

pursuant to Sections 17-13-1000 or 17-13-1100, provided that no Type 1 application permits
issued may be in violation of Section 17-13-0310:

The Applicant is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the Zoning Ordinance, for the
proposed development per the attached Type ! Plans.
